Handoff is written to `oncall-handoff.md`.

Short version: `dep-4471` broke the gateway's connection pool. It shipped at 02:12, flipped a setting called `perRequest` to true, and 33 seconds later the pool started running out of connections. It's still happening as of the last log line, 03:59. Only the gateway was hit, workers stayed healthy the whole time.

Roll back `dep-4471` to fix it.
